## Review Summary — Story 36.6 (Tailoring Matrix, Ledger Candidates, Template Propagation, Epic 36 Recap)

After reviewing all 9 changed files — `tests/test_methodology_tailoring_matrix.py`, `src/agent_learning/methodology_catalog.py`, `docs/project-docs/Methodology-Tailoring-Matrix.md`, `docs/project-docs/Methodology-Best-Practice-Ledger.md`, `docs/project-docs/Lessons-Learned-Register.md`, `.claude/skills/implement-story/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/methodology-catalog/SKILL.md`, `docs/user-stories/epic-36-...md`, and `implementation-log.md` — no merge-blocking defects were found.

**Code correctness:** The new test file correctly anchors all file paths via `Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent` (consistent with LL-006), parses the matrix table robustly, and validates all acceptance criteria including catalog IDs, ledger linkage, hypothesis existence, and the epic recap index check. The `test_ac3` LL-ID extraction (`section[:6]`) works correctly for the `LL-###` format since `re.split` with a lookahead preserves the ID at the start of each section.

**Ledger integrity:** BP-005 through BP-009 are all `candidate` with `evidence_class: source-doc` or `synthetic-demo`, consistent with the adoption invariant. No adopted entries exist. The tailoring matrix rows each reference an existing, current ledger entry whose methodology ID matches the row.

**Skill and register updates:** The `implement-story` and `methodology-catalog` skills are correctly updated to reflect LL-016 through LL-019 lessons and the new tailoring matrix section. The Lessons Learned Register index and detailed entries are consistent.

**Minor observation (non-blocking):** The `_rows()` helper in the test uses bare `assert` for structural invariants (header match, cell count). This is standard in pytest contract tests and does not block merge, though an explicit `ValueError` with a descriptive message would give clearer failures if the matrix format drifts.

This PR is clean for merge.
